sequence: 1x only: load until ready (interact.load.ready-ms), library Add, wait for the waveform and quiet (interact.harness.hook-live)
clip click: empty Stems lane click deselects (Clip Gain fader disabled), then a click on the clip header (interact.click.*, interact.harness.click-live)
zoom with 1 clip: 5 x "=" then 5 x "-", one window per key (interact.zoom.1.*, interact.harness.zoom-live)
drags stopped: range, fade-in, trim start, move; 60 steps, +120 px; reset after each (interact.drag.<d>.stopped.*)
Home (seek to 0), then Space -> playing (interact.play.start-*, 1x: interact.harness.audio-running)
drags playing, each after Home (seek to 0): range, fade-in, trim start, move (interact.drag.<d>.playing.*)
1x only: click the clip header, Ctrl+D x 29 (interact.harness.clips-30), zoom with 30 clips (interact.zoom.30.*), Space, Home, fade-in drag on the first clip (interact.drag.fade.30.playing.*), Space

rows.note: 1x only. Navigation start to ready (library Add enabled and the preview waveform drawn), as load.ready-ms in PERF-1a. Trend only (±30 %).
1x only. React commits seen by the devtools-hook stub from the Add click until the added clip's waveform is drawn and the page is quiet; a disabled hook must fail, not report 0.

1x only. Home (seek to 0) first. 1 only when the Play button aria-label is Pause, a tracked (non-offline) AudioContext reports state running, and at least 1 start() was recorded from the Space press until the page is quiet (at least 1 s); GATE206-S6 rule.

The Clip Gain fader is enabled after Add (the added clip is selected); an empty Stems lane click deselects: the fader is disabled. After the click on the clip header the fader is enabled and there is exactly 1 of it. The fader is always rendered, so enabled state is the selection signal.
React commits from the click until quiet (min 600 ms, then 200 ms without a commit or start(), cap 3 s).
Sum of rendered components over the click window; detail lists the per-commit sizes.
Longest Event Timing entry (>= 16 ms) in the click window; when the observer gives none, the longest long-animation-frame in the window; 0 when neither exists. detail.source names which. Trend only.

The Zoom (px/s) slider value rises on each of the 5 '=' keys, falls on each of the 5 '-' keys, and returns along the same values (value i equals value 10 - i), every value strictly between the slider's min and max (read before the first key; a missing min or max is a problem). The slider steps are integers, so the exact compare is valid.
Commits over the 10 key windows (5 '=' then 5 '-'; each window from the key press until quiet, min 300 ms) / 10.
Sum of rendered components over the 10 key windows / 10.
Largest single commit in any key window.
Longest time from a key press (measured in the page before the press) to the last commit of its window; detail.longestLoafMs is the longest long-animation-frame. Trend only.
